Q076-01.notes: f symmetric about x=2; g(k-x)=f(2k-2x-6) must equal f(4-(2x-6))=f(10-2x), so 2k-6=10, k=8 (g's axis x=4). Trap: k=4 or 7.

Q076-02.notes: u=x^2-4x: u=2sqrt(u+8) -> u^2-4u-32=0 -> u=8 (u=-4 extraneous). x^2-4x-8=0, two real roots 2±2√3, sum 4. Trap: including extraneous x=2 gives 6. Graphing also works.

Q076-03.notes: (x^3-8)/(x^2-4)=(x^2+2x+4)/(x+2); minus (x^2+4)/(x+2) = 2x/(x+2). Can verify with x=0 (choices A,B both give 0) then x=1: 2/3 -> B.
